name: tools-sec-edgar
description: Optional MCP tool add-on: look up US public companies on SEC EDGAR — latest filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), key annual financials, and XBRL concept history. No API key; sends a configurable User-Agent as SEC requires.

sec_user_agent.title: SEC User-Agent
sec_user_agent.description: Descriptive User-Agent with a contact email, as SEC's fair-access policy requests, e.g. "Jane Doe Research jane@example.com". A generic default is used if you leave it unchanged.
sec_user_agent.default: augmentor-packs-sec-edgar/1.1.0 (Claude Code plugin; set sec_user_agent to your name and contact email)
